prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering the onboarding flow (moving sign-in after selection) was helpful (+13.0%).
Redesigning screens with interactive elements hurt performance (-7.6%).
Desktop hint notifications hurt performance (-8.9%), while background notifications showed no clear effect.
Copy changes and guidelines/hints showed no clear effect.
Predictions for flow reordering were accurate (+12.0% predicted vs +13.0% measured).
Predictions were consistently too high for visual redesigns, hint notifications, guidelines, and copy tweaks.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +1.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.0% over 1 test(s)
- finish, notification: -8.9% over 1 test(s)
- home, redesign: -7.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +3.9% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: -1.2% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +13.0% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Preset Pet Quick Selection Flow: Provide an instant preset pet selection flow that skips custom photo upload steps entirely for users wanting starter pets. (why: Adoption stage has the lowest step conversion at 60.9% and takes a median of 89s / mean 1017s due to complex custom photo upload requirements.)
1: [home, redesign] Calm Stage Redesign for Waiting Screen: Redesign the waiting screen using a non-interactive stage layout focused purely on generation status. (why: Home waiting step has a median time of 201s (mean 2336s). Interactive elements previously hurt performance (-7.6%), so a clean non-interactive layout keeps focus simple.)
2: [home, wait_info] Time Estimate Display on Waiting Screen: Enable estimated wait time display on the waiting screen so users know how long generation will take. (why: Users spend a median of 201s (mean 2336s) on the home waiting screen, causing drop-offs when waiting times are unknown.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Two Column Layout for Path Options Screen: Switch choose path layout to a two-column structure to clearly differentiate options side-by-side. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, showing that users take long to compare available options in the default layout.)
4: [adoption, layout] Progress Bar and Step Counter on Upload Screen: Display a progress bar and step counter on the photo upload screen. (why: Adoption drops off significantly to 60.9% and has a long mean completion time of 1017s due to unclear upload progress.)

scores.note: Adoption step has highest drop-off (60.9%); flow shortcuts historically deliver strong positive lift.
Visual screen redesigns consistently hurt conversion (-7.6% previously).
Wait info on home screen previously measured +3.9% lift and is a low-cost config change.
Layout and visual option changes have shown no positive impact in historical tests.
Adoption step loses many users, but hints and visual indicators show negligible historical lift.
